01 / The journey

From finished prints
to complete worlds.

My path wasn’t built in a classroom. It was built by staying curious, becoming the person people called when something needed to look better, and learning how one strong idea can travel across every part of a brand.

  1. 2017

    Learn the physical side

    At Pasadena Printing Company, I handled finished work, supported cutting and finishing, and saw that production details matter as much as the image on screen.

  2. 2018+

    Become the go-to creative

    Independent projects—from Duke Bakery to music clients—taught me how to listen, identify what was missing and translate a need into something customers could actually use.

  3. Live culture

    Design for real audiences

    With SteeJays, graphics became event energy: flyers drove attention, merchandise became part of the experience, and the work had to perform on time in the real world.

  4. Today

    Build the whole system

    Projects like International Rich and Stupid MFs bring identity, web, merchandise, motion and community into one connected visual language.

“I identify what a brand is missing—and bring it to life.”

04 / Background

Self-taught.
Production tested.

I’m Nicholas Hernandez, a Los Angeles-area multidisciplinary creative with an operator’s mindset.

I started in commercial print production in 2017, then built an independent practice spanning music, events, Web3, local business, video and merchandise. I’m comfortable finding the idea, presenting the direction and staying with the work until it becomes something people can use, wear or experience.

I’m looking to bring that range into a collaborative creative team—humble enough to learn the system, confident enough to contribute from day one.

  1. 2017—Now

    Independent Designer & Creative Producer

    Identity, web, campaigns, merchandise, video and client-facing creative direction.

  2. 2022—2023

    Creative Studio Co-Founder

    Artist bookings, production schedules, scripted video concepts, shoots, editing, recording and live commerce.

  3. 2017

    Pasadena Printing Company

    Print handling and delivery, cutting, finishing and exposure to computer-based production workflows.
